raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of civilian firearms, parts, and ammunition to the US market should re-verify ECCN classification, license exception eligibility, and ITAR/EAR jurisdictional boundaries, while maintaining HTS alignment, Section 301 tariff mapping, and restricted party screening. Note that this relief applies to civilian items only; military-grade firearms and controlled components remain subject to strict controls.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了民用枪支及弹药在《出口管理条例》下的许可与分类处理。向美国市场出口民用枪支、零部件及弹药的企业应重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外适用资格以及ITAR/EAR管辖边界，同时保持HTS归类一致、301关税映射和受限方筛查。需注意该放宽仅适用于民用物项，军用级枪支及受控部件仍受严格管制。

checklist.desc: Re-confirm ECCN classification of civilian firearms, parts, and ammunition under the rescinded rule; distinguish EAR-controlled civilian items from ITAR-controlled military items.
Assess whether shipments now qualify for license exceptions (e.g., ENC, TSR, or newly available firearms-related exceptions) and document the basis.
Map the 10-digit HTS line for firearms/ammunition against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Run BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied party screening on consignees and end users; retain end-use and end-user statements.
Where a license is still required, prepare SNAP-R submission with item classification, end-user certificate, and non-military end-use declaration.
Verify DOT/PHMSA hazardous materials classification and packaging for ammunition shipments, plus any EPA lead/chemical reporting obligations.
